title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 081 ]

blocks.text: When I was young, I liked to collect things, but now I like mountain biking.
I joined a mountain biking club where we not only ride bikes, but we also go camping and protect the environment, which are activities I enjoy very much.
I don’t have as much free time these days, so I don’t get to do these things as much as I would like.
I would love to spend more time doing my favorite pastimes when I get a chance.
